adn.resume_en: 11% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 3/10), 63% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 4.9/10), 74% sit on a dark background and 84% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 16% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 42% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 6.5/10, mean brightness 3.4/10, mean complexity 4.4/10. Dominant materials: neon 28%, plastic 25%, metal 9%, glass 9%. Dominant palette: #FFFFFF, #1A1A1A, #0A0A0A, #8B0000, #008080.

composition: Symmetrical tri-partite layout: central focal logo (15-20% width) flanked by left and right text blocks.
Optional asymmetrical collage: 3D character cutout on the left (30% width), central logo, and call-to-action on the right.
Keep elements vertically centered with a minimum 10% top/bottom safety margin.
typographie: Primary title: Bold, italicized, geometric sans-serif in all-caps with a clean white fill.
Secondary text: Medium weight, spaced-out sans-serif, 40% smaller than the primary title.
Custom letterform cutouts or integrated vector icons (e.g., crescent moon, palm tree, lightning bolt) inside the main title.
lumiere: Low-key ambient lighting with a dark vignette focusing light on the center.
Intense neon backlighting or underglow (magenta, cyan, or red) casting a rim light on central elements.
High-contrast studio lighting with strong rim highlights on character cutouts.
etalonnage: Nocturnal/Dark: Deep blacks (#0a0a0a, #0d0214) paired with vibrant neon accents (#8b0000, #8a2be2, #e03a8a).
Summer/Vibrant: High-saturation teal (#008080), pink (#ff3b5c), or green (#00cc44) paired with pure white (#ffffff).
Luxury: Warm golden hour tones (#c5a880) paired with high-exposure white mist.
effets: Soft bokeh particles, light leaks, and subtle smoke/fog overlays.
Faint background patterns: geometric grids, scanlines, or desaturated palm tree silhouettes.
Drop shadows or thin outer strokes on text to separate it from textured backgrounds.
logo: Centralized circular or monogram emblem with a metallic chrome, gold, or neon plastic texture.
Flanked by thin vertical separator lines or enclosed in a thin rectangular frame.
interdits: Avoid centered text without a clear visual anchor or logo.
Do not use low-contrast text-to-background pairings; always use drop shadows or outer strokes if legibility is compromised.
Avoid complex, multi-colored gradients on body text; keep secondary typography solid white or a single neon accent color.
Do not clutter the center; keep a clear hierarchy between the main logo and flanking social handles.
